text: Corpus-admission gate implemented under tools/detector-benchmark: pinned Lund2013 revision and 68 per-file SHA-256 annotations covering 34 recordings (image/dots/video); upstream documented corrected annotation substituted explicitly; complete label counts and paired annotator confusion retained. Reproducible admit.py --check passes; corrupt cached bytes rejected before parsing. Admission discloses 30 annotation files without valid observed timestamps, 5 annotator pairs with different source samples, absent reading coverage and unavailable independent centre/peak-velocity references. This is not a detector performance or release pass. Remaining implementation: explicit timing/validity adapter, frozen matching/splits, actual detector event scoring and robustness curves, and reading corpus admission.
